He tucked the note into his coat pocket, glancing up at his lighthouse’s steady beam, and wondered if she ever made it home.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在浅蓝的雾色里，鳞次栉比的楼宇熄了大半灯火，只有街灯拖着暖黄的光，在空荡的柏油路上拉出长长的影子。主干道上没有白日的车流喧嚣，偶尔有夜班出租车碾过积水，溅起细碎的水花。24小时便利店的灯牌亮得柔和，货架旁的店员打着哈欠整理货架，早起的环卫工已经握着扫帚出现在街角，天边渐渐浮起一层淡粉，新的一天正悄悄掀开帷幕。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a problem solves itself by breaking into smaller, identical versions of the same problem.\n- Every recursive problem has a stop rule, so it won’t repeat forever once it gets the smallest answer.\n- For example, counting nested dolls works recursively: you open one doll to find a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest solid doll."}
